properties.site_typology: Highland agricultural farmstead and moorland clearing
properties.bedrock_geology: Grampian Group Dalradian metasedimentary schist and granite basement overlain by glacial till and peaty podzol soils
properties.ground_plane: Compacted gravel and rutted dirt farm tracks, pasture grasses, and undulating moorland scrub

built_structures.description: Central steel-portal frame agricultural barn with shallow-pitched corrugated fiber cement roof and translucent skylight panels, surrounded by low-pitched timber lean-to sheds
built_structures.rectification: Planarize warped corrugated roof planes, plumb vertical steel posts and timber cladding, sharpen clean gables and roof ridge lines

built_structures.description: Long linear outbuilding / livestock shed to the west with corrugated metal roofing and fieldstone masonry base
built_structures.rectification: De-warp linear eaves, straighten parapets and timber partition walls

built_structures.description: Long ancillary shed to the southeast with weathered profiled tin roofing
built_structures.rectification: Align roof planes, sharpen roof apex and eaves boundaries

properties.vegetation: Native Pinus sylvestris (Scots pine) forest canopy, heather (Calluna vulgaris), bracken, and mixed upland pasture

solar_resynthesis.shadow_behavior: Long, crisp low-angle morning shadows cast westward across the access tracks and dew-covered pasture
